import urllib.request
import json

# Let's check NCBI Gene for human CNOT3 and RTF2
def get_ncbi_gene_info(gene_symbol):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={gene_symbol}[Gene%20Name]+AND+Homo+sapiens[Organism]&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        search_res = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    id_list = search_res["esearchresult"]["idlist"]
    print(f"NCBI Gene ID for {gene_symbol}: {id_list}")
    if id_list:
        summary_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={id_list[0]}&retmode=json"
        req = urllib.request.Request(summary_url, headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            summary_res = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
            doc = summary_res["result"][id_list[0]]
            print(f"{gene_symbol} Name: {doc.get('name')}, Description: {doc.get('description')}")

get_ncbi_gene_info("CNOT3")
get_ncbi_gene_info("RTF2")
